FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Aspen Ridge Pipelines Inc.
REPORTED BY
Field operator
RECEIVED VIA
Text messages
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Got a call from the night shift guy at Kerrobert station. At 06:50 he flagged a relief valve venting
sweet gas on the ops radio. Said it was part of the planned maintenance work. Meter showed
about 850 m³ gone, rate pegged at 2 kg/s. Whole thing inside the fence, no alarms sounding,
valve looked like it was working like it's supposed to. Just wanted us to know before we came in.
No drama, just routine.
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
